To: All Production Staff, Line 3
From: Greta Lindqvist, Plant Operations Manager
Date: March 4
Subject: Scheduled maintenance shutdown

Please be advised that Line 3 will be shut down for scheduled maintenance from Monday, March 11, through Wednesday, March 13. During this period, our contracted technicians from Halverson Industrial Services will replace the conveyor belt motors and recalibrate the packaging sensors, which have caused several slowdowns over the past quarter.

All Line 3 operators will be temporarily reassigned to Line 5, where we are increasing output to meet a large order from Dexfield Appliances. Your shift supervisors will distribute updated schedules by Friday, March 8. Note that the morning shift on Line 5 will begin thirty minutes earlier than usual, at 6:30 A.M., for the duration of the reassignment.

Employees who have completed forklift certification are asked to contact me directly, as we need two additional certified drivers in the loading area during the shutdown. Overtime pay will apply to any hours worked beyond your regular schedule.

Thank you for your flexibility as we complete these necessary upgrades.

Yuna Choi

To: All Warehouse Staff, Norvale Distribution Center
From: Tomasz Krupa, Inventory Control Manager

Subject: New cycle counting procedure

Starting February 1, the Norvale Distribution Center will replace its annual full-facility inventory count with a cycle counting program. Instead of closing the warehouse for two days each December, small sections of inventory will be counted continuously throughout the year.

Under the new system, each aisle will be counted at least once per quarter. High-value items, such as electronics stored in the secured cage, will be counted monthly. Counts will take place during the first hour of the morning shift, before order picking begins, to minimize disruption.

A team of six staff members will be designated as cycle counters on a rotating basis. Counters will use the handheld scanners already in use for receiving; a software update enabling the counting module will be installed on January 25. A mandatory forty-five-minute orientation will be held in the break room on January 28 at 8:00 A.M. and repeated at 2:30 P.M. for the afternoon shift.
